exposure: Residual myometrial thickness (RMT) measured using OmniView and sagittal two-dimensional ultrasound
outcome: Prevalence of lateral uterine wall defects
Reproducibility of OmniView RMT (OV-RMT) and sagittal RMT (S-RMT)
cohort: 208 women with a history of cesarean section in the past 12-18 months
finding: OmniView is a reproducible and reliable method for assessing lateral uterine wall defects, and RMT measured on the coronal plane (OV-RMT) was independently more intact than that measured on the sagittal plane (S-RMT).
